title: Show how many times the document has been viewed
objective: On the document page, show how many times the document has been viewed, next to its title, like "Viewed 4 times", in an element with data-testid="view-count". Every open counts, the owner's included.
acceptance: The Q3 Board Deck (d1, four opens) shows "Viewed 4 times" next to its title
A new open through a link raises the count
plan_summary: Count store.viewsFor(doc.id) in documentPage and render it beside the h1.
